description: This is an HTML file defining the frontend interface of a database viewer application, including layout, styles, and client-side logic for interacting with a backend API to browse databases and tables.
external_files: The file references external API endpoints such as /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, and /api/{db}/tables/{table}/data, but does not directly include external files like scripts or stylesheets.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a specified URL and throws an error if the response contains an error.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with fetched data, including handling wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed viewing.
